skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the psychological characteristics of tourists and other stakeholders in the tourism industry.
Develop effective communication skills for customer service and other activities in the tourism and hospitality industry.
Master active listening skills in the context of tourism and hospitality.
Produce professional documents used in tourism and hospitality businesses.
Deliver persuasive presentations in tourism and hospitality settings.
Build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
Collaborate effectively with peers, superiors, and partners.
Understand cultural nuances in communication across different nationalities.
Handle conflicts and manage relationships in a manner appropriate to the psychological characteristics of stakeholders.
